name: WebWerk Stickers & Overlays
author: Mohammad Loutfi

sections.description:
WebWerk Stickers & Overlays allows you to display attention-grabbing elements such as stickers and overlays on your website.

You can use it to highlight content, guide visitors, or emphasize important messages.

Examples include:

  • Promotional stickers (e.g. SALE, NEW)
  • Floating badges
  • Timed overlays

Use cases:

  • Highlight special offers
  • Draw attention to key content
  • Improve call-to-actions
  • Support landing pages

The plugin provides flexible customization options including colors, text, positioning, and display rules.

It is lightweight and designed to work with any WordPress theme.

Features

  • Up to 3 stickers
  • Custom colors and text
  • Multiple positions (top/bottom, left/right)
  • Device targeting (desktop/mobile)
  • Page and URL rules
  • Date and time scheduling
  • Simple overlay with delay

Additional Extensions

WebWerk Stickers & Overlays is fully functional as provided on WordPress.org.

Optional separate extensions may add additional element types or design options.

All functionality included in this WordPress.org version is available without a license key, payment, trial period, or external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WebWerk Stickers in the admin menu
  4. Create your first sticker
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I control where stickers appear?

Yes, you can define page rules, URLs, devices, and schedules.

Is the free version fully functional?

Yes, the free version includes all functionality described in this listing.
